title: Food Delivery Route Simulator
gallery_text: This project compares different route choices for food delivery riders in the city. It explores how the shortest route is not always the most suitable one, since real-world delivery is also shaped by traffic, bike infrastructure, and access constraints.

answers.interest: I’m interested in this class because I want to better understand how spatial data, rules, and assumptions can be turned into simulations that represent real-world systems. I’m especially interested in agent-based simulation, world models, and interactive tools, and I want to explore not only what a model can predict, but also what it simplifies or leaves out.
answers.suggestions: I would be interested in additional demos or tutorials on agent-based and multi-agent simulation, interactive web-based sandboxes, and spatial world models. I would also find it helpful to see examples of how simulations can be connected to AI agents or natural-language interfaces, especially for projects involving mobility, delivery systems, and urban environments.
